name: mkt-browser
description: Internal MKTTool browser profile runtime derived from MultiZen
_comment_typecheck: typecheck calls tsc directly instead of `workspaces foreach`. With nmHoistingLimits=workspaces the root-only typescript devDependency is invisible inside each workspace, so foreach reported success while every workspace had failed to find tsc.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/settings-store/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/profile-manager/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cdp-driver/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp-server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: yarn workspaces foreach -A run lint && eslint . && node scripts/check-javascript-syntax.cjs
scripts.test:installer: node --test scripts/verify-packaged-runtime-contract.test.cjs scripts/critical-coverage-contract.test.cjs scripts/fingerprint-engine-pin.test.cjs && yarn workspace @mktbrowser/cdp-driver test:safe && yarn workspace @mktbrowser/desktop test:w02 && yarn workspace @mktbrowser/desktop test:mkb01 && yarn workspace @mktbrowser/desktop test:mkb01e && yarn workspace @mktbrowser/desktop test:mkb02 && yarn workspace @mktbrowser/desktop test:mkb03 && yarn workspace @mktbrowser/desktop test:packaging && yarn workspace @mktbrowser/settings-store test && yarn workspace @mktbrowser/profile-manager test:archive
